_doc: Device list (FUN_0041f5xx @ 0x41f5b0-ish, data 0x443614..): each device exposes N logical keys; key index meaning in mini-games: 0,1 = action buttons, 2 = left, 3 = right, 4 = up, 5 = down. Events: {key, up} where up=0 on key-down, 1 on key-up (FUN_0042b570). Held state array also available.

MOUSE.note: 2 mouse buttons (order of L/R INFERRED); cursor position via FUN_00420dc0
